title: Task-Specific Pipelines
summary: This module provides specialized pipelines for common NLP and multimodal tasks like automatic speech recognition, document question answering, and image-text generation, built upon a flexible chunking mechanism.

nodes.label: Automatic Speech Recognition
nodes.title: ASR Pipeline
nodes.description: Transcribes audio inputs into text, supporting various formats, advanced decoding, and timestamp generation.

nodes.label: Document Question Answering
nodes.title: DQA Pipeline
nodes.description: Answers questions based on document images, optionally performing OCR to extract text and bounding boxes, and handling long documents.

nodes.label: Image-Text-to-Text Generation
nodes.title: Image-Text-to-Text Pipeline
nodes.description: Generates text responses from image and text prompts, supporting conversational models and flexible input/output formatting.

nodes.label: Chunking Pipeline Base
nodes.title: Chunking Base
nodes.description: A foundational class for pipelines that process large inputs by dividing them into manageable chunks, managing iteration, batching, and sequential processing steps.

nodes.label: Generic Pipeline Base
nodes.title: Pipeline Base
nodes.description: The fundamental base class for all pipelines, providing common methods for initialization, parameter sanitization, and execution flow.

nodes.label: Model Inference Engine
nodes.title: Model Inference
nodes.description: Executes the underlying pre-trained model to generate predictions or sequences based on processed inputs.

nodes.label: Audio Data Input
nodes.title: Audio Input
nodes.description: Raw audio data in various formats (waveform, file, URL) provided to the ASR pipeline.

nodes.label: Image Data Input
nodes.title: Image Input
nodes.description: Image data (PIL Image, file path, URL) provided to DQA and ITT pipelines.

nodes.label: Textual Prompt/Question
nodes.title: Text Input
nodes.description: Textual prompts, questions, or chat messages provided to the pipelines.

nodes.label: Transcribed Text Output
nodes.title: Transcribed Text
nodes.description: The textual output generated by the Automatic Speech Recognition pipeline, potentially with timestamps.

nodes.label: Document QA Answers Output
nodes.title: QA Answers
nodes.description: Structured answers extracted from documents by the Document Question Answering pipeline, including scores and word indices.

nodes.label: Generated Text Output
nodes.title: Generated Text
nodes.description: Textual content generated by the Image-Text-to-Text pipeline, potentially in a conversational format.

nodes.label: Feature Extraction Module
nodes.title: Feature Extraction
nodes.description: Converts raw input data (audio, image) into numerical features suitable for model input, often involving resampling or image transformations.

nodes.label: Text Tokenization Module
nodes.title: Text Tokenization
nodes.description: Converts raw text into numerical tokens, manages vocabulary, and prepares text for model input and output decoding.

nodes.label: OCR Processing Module
nodes.title: OCR Processing
nodes.description: Extracts text and bounding box information from images, typically used by document-based pipelines when explicit word_boxes are not provided.

groups.label: User-Facing Pipelines
groups.title: User-Facing Pipelines
groups.description: High-level pipelines designed for direct application to specific tasks, abstracting away complex model interactions.

groups.label: Core Pipeline Bases
groups.title: Core Pipeline Bases
groups.description: Fundamental classes that provide the underlying structure and common functionalities for building specialized pipelines.

groups.label: External Data Inputs
groups.title: External Data Inputs
groups.description: Various forms of raw data that serve as initial input for the pipelines.

groups.label: Pipeline Outputs
groups.title: Pipeline Outputs
groups.description: The final processed and structured results produced by the pipelines.

groups.label: Preprocessing Modules
groups.title: Preprocessing Modules
groups.description: Components responsible for transforming raw inputs into a format suitable for model consumption.

groups.label: Model Execution
groups.title: Model Execution
groups.description: The core component responsible for running the underlying machine learning model to generate predictions.
